name: dark
note: Dark style for X posts. Muted off-white is the accent, greys compare, coral only for negatives. Specs name roles, never hex codes. Set your handle here or with INSIGHTS_HANDLE.

roles.compare2: second layer when 3 layers are needed, always lighter than compare
roles.negative: negative, risk, warning. At most once per image
roles.compare3: third layer for 4 data layers. Never next to compare (dE 9.0): put compare2 between them, always with a legend, not for thin lines

layout.note: title anchors at 1 - safe.y, source at safe.y; legend_y and plot_top assume a 1-line title and 1-line subtitle, longer ones push the plot down automatically

validated.result: accent/compare/compare2/compare3 adjacent: CVD PASS (worst compare2 vs compare dE 23.2). All pairs: compare3 vs compare dE 9.0 FAIL, compare3 contrast 2.8:1 WARN. Deliberately monochrome palette.
validated.rule: compare3 never next to compare, always with a legend
